title: AWS re:Invent 2016: Move Exabyte-Scale Data Sets with AWS Snowmobile
summary: AWS's short promo for Snowmobile, a 45-foot shipping container pulled by a semi truck that moves up to 100PB of data to AWS.
why: HN cites it as the example of physically trucking data when network transfer is impractical.

quote.text: You can transfer up to 100PB per Snowmobile, a 45-foot long rugged sized shipping container, pulled by a semi-trailer truck.
